families.name: Local, external-device and cloud import
requires: Existing local media or connected supported device; cloud operations require the user's existing signed-in account.
Inspect the actual Media or Project page before choosing a format or import route.
documentation_notes: JPG, MP4, MOV, INSV, LRV and INSP are documented on both pages. DNG is excluded from Project; MP3 and WAV are excluded from Media; TIFF is unsupported.
Interval/Starlapse photo groups are Media-only. HDR/Night Shot group import has photo-count and matching INSP requirements.
Windows camera import uses USB storage; Bluetooth/wireless camera import is not supported. Format acceptance does not establish every codec/camera's compatibility.

families.name: Media library and preview
requires: Fresh observed Media-page state and a compatible selected file.
documentation_notes: Media is the documented single-footage preview/rough-edit workspace.
Reopening Studio may require reimporting Media-page files; previous edit data remains saved.

families.name: Projects and reusable media libraries
requires: Observed project creation/opening controls and compatible project media.
documentation_notes: Project supports multi-media editing and Project/General/Temporary media libraries.
Temporary Media synchronizes many Media-page edits, but Media-page speed, logo/watermark and Stats edits do not synchronize.
Project files use .insproj; Media edit drafts use .insprj; configuration/library data may use .json.

families.name: Alternative edit drafts
requires: Eligible media and observed Clip Management controls; preserve original footage and existing draft data.
documentation_notes: Create, copy, open and delete alternative clips with separate editing data. Studio always retains at least one clip.
Project migration depends on original media and expected paths; documentation cautions against arbitrary project-file renaming.

families.name: Timeline arrangement and precision controls
requires: A project with selected media on its timeline; observe each tool and shortcut before using it.
documentation_notes: Timeline zoom, main-track magnet, snapping and preview axis are documented.
Split, rearrange, duplicate/delete, undo/redo and frame navigation must use observed installed controls; this source does not establish exact shortcut keys or every operation.

families.name: Trim, TimeShift and motion blur
requires: Eligible selected video; verify current trim/speed controls and their ranges in installed Studio.
documentation_notes: The legacy official ONE R desktop guide covers trim start/end, TimeShift segment speed and motion blur.
Its listed speed values and menu positions are historical reference only; do not treat them as verified 6.0.2 controls.
Media speed edits do not synchronize to Temporary Media.

families.name: Music, volume, fades and audio processing
requires: Project page for imported MP3/WAV music, music library, volume/fades and original-video mute.
Compatible media for available Voice Focus, Noise Reduction or Denoise controls.
documentation_notes: Official instructions describe a single added audio track, music volume, fade durations, original-audio mute and denoise.
Media audio mode and Project audio panels differ; inspect the relevant screen and camera/media eligibility.

families.name: Text and transitions
requires: Project page and observed resource-library/timeline controls; some assets require downloading.
documentation_notes: The Project page provides text and transition resources.
Exact fonts, transition types, duration bounds and editing controls require installed UI observation.

families.name: 360 reframing, FOV and projection
requires: Eligible 360 or FreeFrame source for the requested control; distinguish spherical export from flat reframing.
documentation_notes: 360 video FOV presets include Crystal Ball, Tiny Planet, MegaView, UltraWide, Dewarp and Linear; 360-photo presets include Equirectangular Panorama.
FreeFrame video exposes UltraWide/Dewarp/Linear/Custom options. Flat DNG has its own limited FOV options.

The wide-angle MP4 restriction in this document concerns that media class; file extension alone cannot identify camera mode or eligibility. Ordinary wide-angle video cannot switch FOV/zoom through these controls; flat JPG cannot FOV/crop.

families.name: Keyframes and camera movement parameters
requires: Original eligible 360 video or GO 3 FreeFrame video; confirm installed media eligibility.
Flat Project aspect ratio or reframed Video export for effective keyframes.
documentation_notes: Keyframes exist on Media and Project pages; they do not apply as flat reframing to 360 exports.
Legacy guide documents adding/deleting keyframes, angles and transition interpolation; exact current settings require observation.

families.name: Deep Track subject tracking
requires: Eligible 360 video; excludes Bullet Time and Timelapse.
Observe tracking selection/results and existing Movement/Deep Track state.
documentation_notes: Tracking is documented on Media and Project pages.
Movement and Deep Track cannot both be applied to the same clip.

families.name: Movement templates
requires: Studio v5.8.8 or later; eligible 360 media in a flat-aspect-ratio project.
Observed downloadable template and absence of incompatible tracking/keyframe effects.
documentation_notes: Movement provides predefined camera effects via a resource library.
The official FAQ warns that Movement, Deep Track and keyframe effects cannot be combined freely on one clip; inspect installed eligibility before applying.

families.name: Auto Frame highlight analysis
requires: Media page; 360 video longer than 10 seconds; excludes Timelapse, Bullet Time and Slow Motion.
documentation_notes: Generates candidate highlight clips for review/export.
Documentation says Auto Frame cannot be disabled after enabling; preserve a recoverable edit baseline before analysis.
Auto Frame does not establish one-click AI project editing.

families.name: Stitching and stabilization
requires: Original camera media with required metadata and any paired source files; inspect available stabilization/stitching settings.
documentation_notes: Current Project documentation identifies stitching and stabilization edits as transferable from Media.
Troubleshooting confirms Stitching Optimization and Media Processing can affect performance.
Exact lens-guard/dive-case, FlowState, horizon/direction or optimization options are footage-dependent; this inventory does not mark them validated.

families.name: Image processing, color and noise reduction
requires: Compatible media and observed image/color controls; inspect source metadata and export options.
documentation_notes: Image processing is documented; exact installed color sliders and ranges need observation.
Project v5.9.4+ enables Remove Grain automatically and removes the old checkbox; eligible newer camera media may be analyzed automatically at export.
Studio's LUT documentation describes downloadable LUTs for other applications; it does not prove a native Studio custom-LUT loader.

families.name: Brand, custom-logo and time watermark
requires: Eligible original camera media; Project watermark support requires v5.9.4 or later.
Observed watermark/batch controls and intended logo image.
documentation_notes: Brand watermark offers size/position/angle and appearance controls; time watermark offers opacity/date format.
Camera/brand watermark and time-watermark media restrictions differ; previously exported video may be ineligible.
Media watermark edits do not synchronize through Temporary Media.

families.name: GPS Stats dashboards
requires: Compatible video and GPS data or supported GPX/FIT data; Project dashboards require v5.9.4 or later.
Flat export for visible Stats; inspect time alignment and template elements.
documentation_notes: Documents templates, metric/imperial units, default-disable preference and supported GPS sources.
Timelapse, Starlapse, TimeShift, Slow Motion and Bullet Time are excluded; templates/fields vary with version.
Stats icon-color changes and Stats time correction are not supported in Studio according to this page.
Media Stats edits do not synchronize through Temporary Media.

families.name: File and batch export
requires: Observed export panel, explicit destination and compatible chosen format; verify produced output.
documentation_notes: Documents JPG/MP4/DNG/MOV/INSV export formats, custom destination and sequential local batch export.
Local batch has no documented quantity limit; cloud batch is limited to 10 files.
Source-file export requires qualifying trimmed 360 or trimmed post-stabilization media. Format lists do not imply all choices for every media type.

families.name: Task Center and export records
requires: An observed Task Center window and actual export task/record.
documentation_notes: Task Center reports progress and successful export records.
A record or stable pre-existing file alone does not prove this run created the expected edit; check observed creation, metadata, playback and intended settings.

families.name: Spherical 360 project, Reorient and monitor
requires: Studio v5.6.1 or later; eligible original 360 media and 2:1 (360) project aspect ratio.
documentation_notes: Documents Reorient, 360 Monitor and VR platform/headset export presets.
Flat reframe keyframes do not take effect in spherical 360 output.

families.name: Preferences, paths and hardware codecs
requires: Observed preferences and actual hardware compatibility; keep a recoverable record before changing defaults.
documentation_notes: Player/exporter hardware codecs, automatic hardware detection, project-file save path, external-device detection and default Stats behavior are documented.
Do not infer an encoder/decoder option is available from NVIDIA/CUDA documentation alone; observe installed hardware and UI.

families.name: Proxy and preview performance
requires: Project performance controls and compatible proxy/media pairing; inspect preview quality settings.
documentation_notes: Official Windows guidance identifies Low-resolution proxy, Ultra HD Preview, hardware acceleration and stitching/processing controls.
Project low-resolution proxies and camera .lrv files are related preview media; original files remain necessary for full output.

families.name: Interface language
requires: Observed Windows Menu > Settings > Language controls.
documentation_notes: Studio supports language changes; menu labels/screens may differ from documentation.

families.name: Direct audio recording in Studio
documentation_notes: Official Studio documentation says direct recording and applying that sound to footage is not supported.

families.name: Multiple added audio tracks
documentation_notes: Official current documentation describes only one added audio track. This restriction does not deny the existence of original video audio.

families.name: Export gyroscope data
documentation_notes: Official File Export FAQ says gyroscope-data export is not supported.

families.name: One-click AI editing
documentation_notes: Official Studio Auto Frame FAQ says AI editing is not supported and recommends Auto Frame for candidate highlights instead.

limitations: Documentation was checked on 2026-10-14; the target installation is Studio 6.0.2. Sources describe current and sometimes older layouts, not a version-pinned automation API.

available_through_observed_UI means the MCP has an observation and generic input route for visible Studio controls. It does not mean that the listed task family has completed a live test. Inspect the current screen before input and merge separate validation evidence.

Current local workflow evidence is in VALIDATION-V4.md and validation-v4.json, with v3 then v2 as compatibility fallbacks when newer records are unavailable. VALIDATION.md and the v2/v3 records preserve history; documentation availability alone is not live workflow proof.
File extension alone does not identify original camera mode, metadata, codec compatibility or paired-media completeness. Determine capability from media and installed controls.
Exact shortcuts, split controls, color parameters, ranges and preferences must be inspected in installed Studio. Historical guide positions/ranges are not hard-coded promises.
Original source media must remain intact. Delivered input and observed workflow success are separate evidence. Long exported files need appropriate full-file decoding and visual/audio review.

The optional expected_projection=equirectangular export check requires recognized unambiguous spherical stream metadata. A 2:1 image or arbitrary tag alone does not qualify; declared projection does not prove stitching quality or complete spherical coverage.
The server remains limited to the pinned Studio executable and its owned dialogs; this inventory does not add arbitrary shell execution, other-app control, credentials or external publishing.
